name: dsh-task-ledger
description: Tasks are created, claimed, advanced and closed by the agent and written straight into a plain-text ledger in the workspace, so the owner, the current state and the next step are always on record. It is not limited to development work — research, documentation, presentations and video production all fit. No cloud service is involved: everything is managed locally. Single-user and multi-user both work, with Git synchronisation, and every action is on record. The control panel summarises in-flight, overdue and stalled work with weekly trends.

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:client
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node scripts/verify-skill.mjs
